text:
sam.khan: Hey team — I realized my state taxes look wrong on paystubs. I moved from CA to NY on 2025-06-14 but my paycheck still shows CA state withholding for the rest of the year. Can we get this corrected retroactively and get an updated W-2 if needed? I opened a payroll ticket PR-4521.

maria-peopleops: Thanks for flagging, Sam. Can you DM your exact move date and the new NY address? Also upload your last 2 paystubs to the HR portal so payroll can validate YTD allocations.

sam.khan: Sent you a DM with the date and address, and I uploaded the paystubs to the portal. Quick Q: if CA was withheld by mistake, will I owe taxes or should I expect a refund when filing? :thinking_face:

alex-payroll: Looping in payroll ops. We'll review allocations and coordinate a multi-state wage allocation. If CA was withheld in error for post-move pay periods we typically issue a W-2c to correct state wages and withholding, or the vendor may reallocate YTD wages. Timeline is vendor-dependent — usually 2–4 weeks after we provide docs. I've added a note to PR-4521.

payroll-bot: Ticket PR-4521 status: Investigating — awaiting supporting documents from employee (paystubs and proof of move).

maria-peopleops: Heads-up: you may need to file part-year returns for CA and NY. We'll include guidance in the ticket and point you to the tax resources. If you need help estimating payments for any gap, we can connect you with our tax partner.

sam.khan: Appreciate that. Also wondering whether this will change my 401(k) deferral/year-to-date contributions or benefits deductions?

alex-payroll: Contributions themselves shouldn't change — this is a state wage allocation issue. If we process a retro adjustment to gross for state allocation, payroll will note any mechanical changes that affect YTD boxes, but your pre-tax retirement deferrals remain based on gross. We'll flag any downstream effects in PR-4521.

maria-peopleops: To expedite: please email a signed copy of your change-of-address and the NY withholding form to hr-payroll@redwood.com with subject line: PR-4521 — Sam Khan, or use HR portal > Payroll > Upload Documents.

sam.khan: Emailed docs a few minutes ago with subject "PR-4521 — Sam Khan". Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

alex-payroll: Got it. I'll update the ticket and follow up after vendor confirms next steps. Expect an update by 2026-01-30. If anything changes earlier we'll ping you here.

maria-peopleops: Thanks everyone — I'll close the loop once payroll confirms W-2/W-2c plan. :white_check_mark:
